SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS INV_NO, KEY_2 AS INV_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL C WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND KEY_10 in ('N','A') AND TARGET IN ('KRCHAN0058','KRCHAN0059','KRCHAN0060','KRDONG0708')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'A0' AS PLANT, A.KEY_1 AS LEGACY_IV_NO, A.KEY_2 AS LEGACY_IV_SEQ, A.KEY_3 AS STATUS, f_split(a.key_4,'^',1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, f_split(a.key_4,'^',2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.KEY_5 AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT, A.KEY_6 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.KEY_7 AS ITEM_QTY, A.KEY_8 AS INV_DATE FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_10 in ('A','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 in ('A','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 in ('A','N')
